title: Sales performance dashboard
problem: regional managers waited a full day for the weekly sales pack
approach: modelled sales, targets and stores and built drill-down pages with row-level filters
results: weekly reporting from 1 day to 15 minutes

title: Modern data stack migration
problem: finance and product disagreed on revenue numbers
approach: loaded sources into Snowflake and rebuilt the metrics layer as tested SQL models

title: Marketing attribution analysis
problem: the team credited every sale to the last click
approach: built position-based and data-driven attribution from event-level data
results: reallocated 18% of ad spend to higher-ROAS channels
ROAS up 0.4 points the next quarter

title: Cohort retention analysis
problem: the app grew sign-ups but revenue stayed flat
approach: built weekly cohorts and retention curves by acquisition channel
results: an onboarding change lifted day-30 retention by 4 points

title: A/B test analysis framework
problem: product teams declared winners after two days of data
approach: wrote a standard analysis notebook with guardrail metrics and sequential testing rules

title: Excel reporting automation
problem: a coordinator copied data between workbooks every Monday
approach: automated imports, cleaning and the summary report with one button

title: Executive KPI dashboards
problem: executives received 20 static PDFs each month
approach: designed a KPI tree and interactive dashboards with consistent definitions

title: Customer survey analysis
problem: a hotel chain collected surveys but never analysed the comments
approach: weighted responses, ran driver analysis and coded open text

title: Inventory forecasting in Google Sheets
problem: a small retailer ran out of best-sellers every month
approach: built a reorder model with seasonality and lead times inside the sheet they already used
results: owner reorders in 10 minutes a week

title: ETL pipeline for advertising platforms
problem: analysts downloaded CSVs from seven ad platforms
approach: built daily extract-and-load jobs with schema checks and alerting
results: reporting delay from 3 days to same-day

title: Churn driver analysis
problem: leadership wanted to know why customers left
approach: joined usage, billing and support data and fitted an interpretable model
results: a billing fix reduced churn calls

title: Financial reporting model
problem: the founder rebuilt the board pack by hand every month
approach: built a driver-based model and a linked reporting layer
results: board pack produced in 2 hours instead of 2 days

title: CRM data cleaning and de-duplication
problem: donor records were duplicated across three systems
approach: standardised fields, matched records with fuzzy rules and documented merge decisions

title: Self-serve analytics with Metabase
problem: every metric question went through one analyst
approach: set up curated models, saved questions and training for the team

title: GA4 migration and tracking plan
problem: the old analytics property was being switched off
approach: designed an event tracking plan, implemented it in the tag manager and rebuilt reports
results: funnel reports live before the cut-over

title: Pricing elasticity analysis
problem: prices had not changed in three years despite rising costs
approach: estimated elasticity per product line from promotions history
results: recommended price change lifted margin by 3.2%

title: Slow report query optimisation
problem: a daily reconciliation report took 14 minutes and timed out
approach: rewrote the query plan, removed correlated subqueries and added summary tables
results: report runtime from 14 minutes to 40 seconds

title: Store location analysis
problem: a chain chose new sites by gut feeling
approach: combined demographics, footfall proxies and competitor locations into a site score
